purpose: Approximate contact-material routing for Audio/FX from the frozen seven v1GLB assets; no runtime mutation.

scope.measured: POSITION buffer data decoded from each material primitive, node world transforms applied; min/max recomputed, not copied from authoring scripts.
scope.semantic_zones: Deliberately coarse exposed-surface regions informed by measured GLB material bounds plus the delivered part construction; overlapping materials are labelled mixed.

coordinates.runtime_projection: d=dot(contact-hand,normalize(tip-hand)); L=length(tip-hand); alphaPosed=d/L. hand=mainHand for primary, offHand for knife.
coordinates.rest_normalization: alphaRest=s/rest_reach_m; use rest_along_m or alphaRest to lookup zones. Do not compare alphaPosed directly to rest-zone alpha thresholds.
coordinates.rendered_extension: E=L-rest_reach_m; renderer uses F(s)=s+E*clamp((s-a)/(b-a),0,1), [a,b]=deformation_m. Grip/heads are not uniformly scaled.
coordinates.inverse_rendered_extension: If d<=a: s=d. If d>=b+E: s=d-E. Else s=a+(d-a)/(1+E/(b-a)). This is the monotonic inverse for the current legal equipment range.
coordinates.shields: Invert current equipmentTransform shield sx/sy around offHand before classifying local XY regions. GLB depth Z is unchanged by guard sx/sy.
coordinates.fallback_when_contact_position_missing: Use explicit runtime material/palm evidence first, then key+equipment fallback. Mixed remains mixed; never guess a precise face from an AABB.

runtime_key_policy.explicit_material: An existing explicit material=wood/palm contact wins over a broad weapon body key; main-palm/off-palm are character timber, outside this item contract.
runtime_key_policy.weapon: Shaft/whole primary proxy. Resolve by equipment id and recovered rest along. A weapon body is not automatically metal.
runtime_key_policy.weapon-head: Wide axe/maul proxy, still body weapon. Axe fallback steel; maul fallback wood_metal_mixed. The key alone cannot identify a clamp or steel shoe.
runtime_key_policy.defenses: Current shield/dagger guard contacts have no universal weapon-head material key; combine defense id with known face/rim/back context. These logical zones do not add colliders or events.
runtime_key_policy.missing_contact_location: sword->steel; spear->wood; axe weapon->wood and weapon-head->steel; maul weapon->wood and weapon-head->wood_metal_mixed; short guard->metal_mixed; long guard->wood; knife parry->steel.

material_families.cloth_note: The actual seven v1 assets contain no cloth material primitives. Leather damping is not evidence of fabric.

pair_routing_priority.condition: Explicit collision body material already resolves character wood or another authoritative surface.
pair_routing_priority.route: Preserve that material; do not override with weapon id.
metal impact/clang family; metal detail may be secondary to mass/impulse. No automatic sparks from material alone.

pair_routing_priority.condition: Wood against metal, or unresolved maul mixed head.
pair_routing_priority.route: wood/thud body with optional short metal accent; do not promote every mixed overlap to a full sustained clang.

pair_routing_priority.condition: Leather or explicitly known cloth at the actual surface.
pair_routing_priority.route: damped contact; underlying wood/metal may remain a quiet transient. No cloth is delivered in this asset set.

pair_routing_priority.condition: Small enamel coat, engraving or tiny fastener overlaps a larger exposed surface.
pair_routing_priority.route: Route the structural/exposed substrate; do not create a separate impact solely from decoration.
